question: What should a homeowner verify before applying for PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy?
cycleNotice: The reviewed sources refer to the "2024-25" cycle, which precedes the current decision period. Treat dates and values as potentially outdated.

sources.title: PM Surya Ghar Official Scheme Portal
sources.rawText: Central Financial Assistance provides Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW capacity. Apply at https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in. Installations require net metering approval from regional discom.
sources.cleanedText: Central Financial Assistance provides Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW capacity. Apply at https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in. Installations require net metering approval from regional discom.

sources.title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Specifications
sources.rawText: Subsidy rate is fixed at Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW. Technical specifications mandate 100 sq ft shadow-free roof area per kilowatt installed.
sources.cleanedText: Subsidy rate is fixed at Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW. Technical specifications mandate 100 sq ft shadow-free roof area per kilowatt installed.

sources.title: State Electricity Distribution Regulatory Procedure
sources.rawText: Grid interconnection rules state installations above 3 kW are subject to gross metering only. CFA subsidy benchmark of Rs 30,000 per kW applies.
sources.cleanedText: Grid interconnection rules state installations above 3 kW are subject to gross metering only. CFA subsidy benchmark of Rs 30,000 per kW applies.

sources.title: Indian Solar Consumer Forum Discussion
sources.rawText: Discom technical feasibility inspection must be completed before net meter installation.
sources.cleanedText: Discom technical feasibility inspection must be completed before net meter installation.

sources.title: Clean Energy Weekly Blog (2024 Edition)
sources.rawText: The 2024-25 phase allocated rooftop subsidies with earlier vendor registration lists.
sources.cleanedText: The 2024-25 phase allocated rooftop subsidies with earlier vendor registration lists.

sources.title: Energy Times Consumer Bulletin
sources.rawText: The special early-bird window application deadline was 22 June 2025 across participating states.
